# Release train and holds: is this moment mine?

## What this region is

The release cascade: walks each lane in dependency order, publishes what is ahead of npm, records it as a candidate, lets failing dependents adopt it on branches, promotes the candidates nothing holds, and ships @inixiative/config last so the BOM names the new state; holds keep a breaking line out meanwhile.

## What it exists for

- Ship a new version and move repos onto it
- Get dependents onto a newly published version without blocking the release
- Understand a train that wouldn't run or skipped a repo
- Keep a package's breaking line out of the blessed set

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- check every checkout under my root for drift → version-coherence
- which signet version is blessed right now → version-coherence
- fix a stale bun.lock in this one repo → version-coherence
- set up CI for a new library repo → version-coherence
- CI flags an old product name in a package description → retired-terms
